name: GRUMPY GRAN! (SCARY OBBY)
desc:
Sniff...Sniff...What's that smell?? OMG Grandma has baked her famous Cookies!! Looks like we are on a mission to steal those cookies!
Grandma will lose her temper if we eat them before dinner time BUT THEY ARE TOO TASTY TO RESIST!
Steal grandmas cookies and make your escape to the Tree House where Granny can't get you.
Get through the 19 fun challenges and prepare for your final showdown with GRANDMA!!

If you have beat the game in easy mode why not try beat the game on HARD MODE?

Sorry for the delay in games we have been busy with new projects and ready for some upcoming new games!

Please support the game by leaving a like and favorite :)
Thankyou
